# v28 Part E, extra: the spread over the masks (descriptive; generated by extra_v28.py)

Written after the results of Part E were seen (`DECISIONS.md`). No test. `summary_E.md` E.3 gives, per size and rate, the mask with the largest loss of
`LB_noVLrep` against the main row. X.4 puts the mask with the largest gain next to it, and counts the masks in which the row without the reports is
behind the main row (lower THR, higher LAT). V_m: the mean over the two traffic patterns and the two seeds of ln(`LB_noVLrep` / main row), as a percentage.
